description: Longer, hands-on studies of single papers or methods that came out of this research: learn the theory, rebuild the work in code, then test an extension of my own.

dives.title: LatentToM learning plan
dives.summary: Rebuild Latent Theory of Mind in a 2D two-pusher simulation. Seven modules from diffusion policy through sheaf theory to a full ablation report, plus an optional extension that removes the shared third-person camera to see whether the arms can still reach consensus.
dives.scope: About 90 hours, roughly 11 weeks at 8 hours a week
